deltas.source_contract: A person engages one story-relevant scene element; a contextual cue is readable; framing keeps the action and cue together. Conditions: human subject and a portrait/fashion presentation.
deltas.baseline_evidence: The person stands in an unhurried pause beside the glass windbreak; the receding pier appears behind in the glass.
deltas.final_evidence: The person pauses mid-turn toward the receding pier; the glance connects the person to the crossing; the receding pier and open shoreline remain legible behind.
deltas.unbound_choices: The ferry, pose, clothing, lighting, and view remain authorial choices. No occupation, age, or identity is added.
deltas.reason: This changes the static pause into an observable attention-to-context action and preserves the related pier cue in the same full-length image. The effect is generic scene relation, not the source contextual_usage interpretation.
deltas.pixel_check: The person’s gaze/turn must visibly point toward the receding pier while the person and pier remain readable in the same frame; shoulders and hips must connect naturally.
final_literal_clauses: The person pauses mid-turn toward the receding pier, shoulders and hips turning together in an easy three-quarter view; the glance connects the person to the crossing without turning the moment into a formal pose.

A generous full-length frame keeps the person's visible face, hair, and layered outline readable while showing both shoe soles resting flat on the same ferry deck, the person's weight balanced over both feet, and deck around the shoes; the receding pier and open shoreline remain legible behind.

deltas.source_contract: Overcast skylight yields broad gentle transitions on person and surroundings while local support contact remains legible. No candidate prerequisites.
deltas.baseline_evidence: Cool sky light washes the glass, crossed by a narrow warm cabin reflection.
deltas.final_evidence: Overcast skylight creates broad, gentle transitions across the person’s face, clothing, and ferry surfaces, leaving the flat sole-to-deck contacts readable.
deltas.unbound_choices: The overcast condition, light behavior, and receiving surfaces are authorial scene choices; no requester weather or camera condition is added.
deltas.reason: This is a complete generic lighting relation across the person and nearby ferry surfaces, and the already required flat shoe/deck contact stays legible under it. It does not use the source’s keyword list as a hard fact.
deltas.pixel_check: Broad soft light transitions must be visible on face/clothing and ferry surfaces together, with both sole-to-deck contacts still readable.
final_literal_clauses: Overcast skylight creates broad, gentle transitions across the person's face, clothing, and ferry surfaces, leaving the flat sole-to-deck contacts readable; a narrow warm cabin reflection crosses the windbreak glass and echoes the profile.
